title: Phase 1 — parsekit identity, schema, and configs repo skeleton
description: Create github.com/FreshlyBakedNYC/parsekit-configs with directory layout from EPIC_PLAN.md. Commit release.json schema, use-cases/pending-purchases/ skeleton, and an empty metrc-v1 dialect file. Add a `self-deploy-configs` wrapper (in this automation repo) that fetches the configs repo + atomically swaps /var/lib/parsekit-configs/current. Document the contract between deploy and loader (manifest-last write, symlink swap).

title: Phase 2 — parsekit core: AST types, compiler, static safety verifier
description: Implement helios/src/lib/parsekit/{types,compile,verify,parse}.ts. AST = Expr discriminated union per EPIC_PLAN. Compiler turns Expr + DialectPack → arcsecond parser. Static verifier enforces: acyclic ref/macro graph, bounded repeat/sepBy (max required), max AST depth, max choice fanout, projection allowlist (no fields outside output schema), transform allowlist with arg Zod schemas. Add @freshly-baked/parsekit package boundary (subpath export from helios). Pure isomorphic — no Node-only deps. Unit tests for every combinator and every verifier rule.

title: Phase 3 — parsekit/node ReleaseLoader + atomic generation swap
description: Implement helios/src/lib/parsekit/node/{loader,reload,pager}.ts. ReleaseLoader: read release.json from watch location, parse all referenced JSONC files, Zod-validate shapes, compile dependency closure, run scoped goldens, atomic generation pointer swap with in-flight refcount. fs.watch + git pull poll trigger reload; SHA in release.json is the truth. createPageDavePager() shells out to `page-dave -p 5 -t '...' '...'` via spawn (not shell). Throttle pages on (tenantId, headSha, errorHash). Tests cover: stale fs.watch event, manifest-missing-references rejection, per-tenant compile failure isolation (sibling tenants keep advancing), stuck-generation timeout paging.

title: Phase 4 — metrc-v1 dialect pack
description: Implement helios/src/lib/parsekit/dialects/metrc-v1.ts. DialectPack id='metrc-v1', version=1. Tokens: dash, slash, pipe, lparen, rparen, ws, optWs, int, decimal, grams, milligrams, prevalenceSuffix (I|S|H), word, wordsUntil(delimiter). Macros: brand-dash-group-dash-family-dash-size, brand-dash-group-dash-family-dash-count, curaleaf-hyphen-series, family-tail-size. Transforms (versioned, Zod arg schemas): normalizeBrand, cleanCultivar, normalizeSizeText, unitSizeFromTotalSizeAndPackCount, unitMgFromTotalMgAndPackCount, prevalenceFromSuffix, defaultStrainNameFromGroup, blankStrainForCategory, inferVariantTab, inferVariantName, defaultSearchTermFromGroup, appendGroupSuffix. UseCaseContract<ParsedProductName> with outputSchema (Zod) + semanticValidate (port logic from normalizeAndValidateParsedProductName). Determinism + golden tests for each transform.

title: Phase 5 — parsekit test harness (goldens + corpus replay + diff)
description: Implement helios/src/lib/parsekit/harness/{goldens,corpus,diff}.ts. runScopedGoldens(release, changedParserIds) — runs changed-rule goldens + overlapping-priority siblings + smoke slice + collision scan. replayCorpus(release, corpus, oracle) — runs a corpus through parsekit and against a `oracle(name)` callback (legacy parseProductName), produces diff report (parity %, regressed names, new-coverage names). CI/nightly script wires full corpus + parity threshold check. Tests against a small synthetic corpus.

title: Phase 6 — port 12 hardcoded METRC parsers to JSONC tenant configs
description: Convert parseCuraleafName, parseBytesName, parseOutrankdName, parseTheGramName, parseMoonlitName, parseSmartbudName, parseHerbCodeName, parseJennysName, parsePoshPuffName, parseLayUpName, parseCannabalsName, parseHrBotanicalName into parsers/<tenantId>.jsonc files in the parsekit-configs repo. Each rule MUST carry full goldens (positive + at least one no_match) derived from existing TS test suite + historical pending-purchase rows. Use scripts/seed-goldens-from-legacy.mjs to bootstrap. Verify per-tenant goldens green via the Phase 5 harness.

title: Phase 7 — shadow mode integration in generatePendingPurchasePacketJob
description: Add helios/src/worker/pendingPurchases/parsekitShadow.ts. parsePendingPurchaseProductName({ rawName, tenantHint, distributorNames }) calls BOTH legacy parseProductName AND parsekit; logs structured diffs via existing observation surface; returns legacy result. No behavior change. After N days of shadow logs, generate parity report. Document the threshold (>=99.5% per-tenant parity, no critical-field regressions) required for cutover.

title: Phase 8 — cutover with kill-switch fallback
description: Flip parsePendingPurchaseProductName to use parsekit primary, legacy as PARSEKIT_LEGACY_FALLBACK=1 escape hatch. Delete the legacy dispatch tree from generatePendingPurchasePacketJob.ts in a follow-up after one release window of clean operation. Add a runbook entry on enabling the kill-switch.

title: Phase 9 — DB schema: parser_combinator rule kind + learning_candidates table
description: Migration: ALTER TYPE pending_purchase_parse_rule_kind ADD VALUE 'parser_combinator'. Add columns to pending_purchase_parse_rules for config_rule_id, config_commit_sha (text). Freeze application writes to rule_kind='regex'|'template' (queries refuse). Create new table parsekit_learning_candidates(id, scope_tenant_id, scope_use_case, normalized_input, raw_input, snapshot_sha, reason, proposal_fingerprint, status, lease_owner, lease_expires_at, attempt_count, created_at, updated_at) with unique index on (scope_tenant_id, scope_use_case, normalized_input, snapshot_sha). Forward-only + tested rollback.

title: Phase 10 — single-writer reconciler service
description: Implement helios/src/worker/jobs/parsekitReconcilerJob.ts as a singleton-leased worker (uses existing jobPools singleton mechanism). Loop: dequeue candidate → git pull --ff-only on configs repo working clone → call Bedrock-Mantle via existing LLM path (constrained JSON-mode, see Phase 11) for a CanonicalEdit[] proposal → applyCanonicalEdits → static safety verify → runScopedGoldens → if auto-merge allowed (whitelist: addGolden, setRulePriority, exact-literal upsertRule): commit + push directly; else open PR via gh CLI. On push reject: refetch, rebase, retry up to 3 times then mark candidate failed + page. Mark candidate succeeded/superseded/rejected.

title: Phase 11 — LLM gap-fill prompt + JSON-mode proposal schema
description: Implement helios/src/lib/parsekit/llm/{prompt,proposal}.ts. ProposalSchema (Zod): { rationale: string, confidence: number, edits: CanonicalEdit[], goldens_added: GoldenCase[] }. Prompt template includes: failing raw input, scope, current parser slice, dialect reference (auto-generated from DialectPack), nearest existing goldens, hints (manifest/free-text), and explicit instruction that generalized rules must be explainable from the raw name alone. Sanitization: raw input quoted as JSON data, never interpolated into instruction text. Prompt-injection unit tests against malicious distributor names.

title: Phase 12 — read-only browser review UI
description: Add helios/src/client/parsekit/ pages. Loads compiled snapshot JSON (served by a new server endpoint that ships parseable subset only — no secrets, no Node-only fields). Reviewer can: pick a tenant + use-case, paste a raw input, see parse trace (rule tried → captures → projection → transforms → output → semantic result), browse goldens, see proposal-queue status. No git, no JSONC authoring, no LLM. v2 would add authoring.

title: Phase 13 — runbook + epic closure
description: Write docs/helios/parsekit/RUNBOOK.md: configs repo edit workflow, self-deploy-configs usage, kill-switch toggling, reconciler queue inspection, page-dave alert interpretation, common failure recovery (stuck generation, push reject loop, broken tenant rollback). Update helios AGENTS.md with parsekit pointers. Close the epic.
